Your droplet is on DigitalOcean. 192.168.4.x is your home LAN. A cloud server can’t route to it unless you’ve built a VPN/tunnel.

from shellfish-droplet, it’s basically “try to reach a private address that only exists inside your house.”

ssh pi@192.168.4.38      # lucidia
ssh pi@192.168.4.64      # blackroad-pi

export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="YOUR_KEY_HERE"
claude
